race.definition: A race is when people compete to see who is the fastest at either driving or running.
race.sentence: There was a race to see who could finish first.

racial.definition: If something is racial, it is related to the skin color (race) of people.

radical.definition: A radical change, difference, etc. is very big and important; from the roots.
radical.sentence: The plan will not be easy and requires a radical change in the culture of the city.

radio.definition: A radio is piece of electronic equipment that sends or receives signals though the air and plays voice, music, or other sounds.
radio.sentence: When I'm in the car, I usually listen to the radio.

rail.definition: A rail is a long and thin piece of metal.

rain.definition: Drops of water that fall out of clouds in the sky.
rain.sentence: I do not like going outside in the rain.

raise.definition: If you raise something you make it higher; that is you move it up.
raise.sentence: I need to raise the car off the ground to fix it from below.

random.definition: If something is random, there is no purpose, reason, or pattern.
random.sentence: I have to sit there like typing in random keywords to see if it's a keyword.

range.definition: A range of X is a number of different kinds of Xs.
range.sentence: We offer you a whole range of clothes, from socks to hats.

rank.definition: A rank is the position of a person, place, thing, or idea in relation to others based on a shared property such as location, population, or quality.
rank.sentence: His salary was determined by his rank and seniority.

rapid.definition: If an action or idea is rapid, it happens quickly.
rapid.sentence: A rapid rise through the ranks.

rapidly.definition: If something is done rapidly, then it is done quickly or swiftly.

rare.definition: If something is rare, you seldom see it or there are only a few.
rare.sentence: It's rare to have snow in June.

rarely.definition: When something happens rarely, it almost never happens.
rarely.sentence: When the stars come at night, I rarely see the North Star.

rat.definition: Rats are medium-sized rodents. They often live near people and eat garbage. Rats can carry diseases. They are also kept as pets and can be very tame.
rat.sentence: I caught the rat that was eating our food.

rate.definition: Speed. A rate is how fast something happens. Something can go at a fast rate or a slow rate.
rate.sentence: The rate of water pouring out of the lake into the river is enough to make the lake empty in a year if it doesn't rain.

rather.definition: If something is rather large, different, difficult, etc., it is quite that way.
rather.sentence: I saw something rather unusual this morning.

ratio.definition: A ratio is the comparison in size or number between two things. It is written x:y and read x to y. It is the same as the fraction x/y.
ratio.sentence: The low student/teacher ratio makes this a great school.

raw.definition: If something is raw, it has not been cooked, processed, prepared, etc.
raw.sentence: You should wash your hands after touching raw meat.

reach.definition: If you reach a level, you get to that level.
reach.sentence: Seven mice were born, six living long enough to reach adulthood.

react.definition: If you react to a person or event, you do something because of the person or event.
react.sentence: When someone shouts at you, you usually react by shouting back.

reaction.definition: A reaction is an action that happens because of another action.
reaction.sentence: When he asked her to lunch, her first reaction was to say no.

read.definition: Someone is reading when they are looking at a book or other writing and understanding what it says.

reader.definition: A reader is somebody or something that reads.
reader.sentence: I would describe myself as a reader because I'm always reading books.

real.definition: A thing that is true is real.
real.sentence: Strange as the story sounded, the story was real.

reality.definition: Reality is what actually is. Reality is what is real.
reality.sentence: I'm sure you'd like to get everything you want for free, but that isn't reality.

realize.definition: If you realize something, you become aware of it.
realize.sentence: It took me some time to realize it was you.

really.definition: When something is really a certain way, its very or very much that way.
really.sentence: I really want to see a film.

rear.definition: The back of something; something that is behind.
rear.sentence: I painted the rear of the house.

reason.definition: A reason to do something is why you do it, or the cause of something.
reason.sentence: The low price was the main reason for buying it.

reasonable.definition: A reasonable amount or number is not too much or too big.
reasonable.sentence: The hotel has good food, and the prices are reasonable.

reasonably.definition: If something is done reasonably, it is done in a reasonable way.

recall.definition: If you recall something, you think about something you learned or experienced in the past.
recall.sentence: I don't recall seeing any situation like that.

receive.definition: When you receive something, you get something that was sent or given to you.
receive.sentence: I receive letters in the mail every day.

recent.definition: Something that is recent has happened a short while ago.
recent.sentence: Has there been any recent news on the dispute?

recently.definition: Something that happened recently happened shortly before now.

reckon.definition: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.
reckon.sentence: What do you reckon we should do?

recognition.definition: Recognition is the act of recognizing somebody or something.
recognition.sentence: Computers are getting much better at facial recognition.

recognize.definition: If you recognize something, you realize what it is.
recognize.sentence: I don't recognize him. Is he a friend of yours?

recommend.definition: If you recommend something, you tell somebody that it is good or that they should try it.

recommendation.definition: A recommendation is something you tell people that they should do, buy, see because it is good.
recommendation.sentence: Her pleasant personality is already a recommendation.

record.definition: A record is something in writing to tell what happened.
record.sentence: Keep a record of the date and what you said every time you talk to that person.

recover.definition: If you recover, you get better after getting sick, or being hurt, surprised, etc.
recover.sentence: Her doctors say she may never completely recover.

recovery.definition: A recovery is the process of getting better after an illness or a problem.
recovery.sentence: She made a good recovery from a knee injury and may play this game.

recruit.definition: If you recruit people, you try to get them to come and work or study with you or to join your group.
recruit.sentence: The university will actively recruit good students from disadvantaged backgrounds.

red.definition: Red is a color of blood, a rose, an apple, and so on.
red.sentence: The company operated in the red last year.

reduce.definition: If something is reduced, it has been brought down or made smaller.
reduce.sentence: The new computer system should reduce the number of problems.

reduction.definition: A reduction is how much something is reduced.

refer.definition: If you refer to something, you talk or write about it, usually in passing.
refer.sentence: You should refer to the dictionary to find the meaning.

reference.definition: A reference is something that can be compared to.
reference.sentence: When making your model, use the model I created as a reference.

reflect.definition: If x reflects y, x shows or matches y, or x is affected by y.
reflect.sentence: These words didn't accurately reflect his thoughts.

reflection.definition: A reflection is an image made by reflected light, such as what you see in a mirror.
reflection.sentence: The baby tried to touch his reflection in the water.

reform.definition: A reform is a change to an institution's rules or ways something works to improve it.
reform.sentence: Justice was for sale before the reform of the law courts.

refugee.definition: A refugee is a person who is forced to leave their own country in order to escape war or natural disasters.

refuse.definition: If you refuse a request or demand, you decline or reject it.
refuse.sentence: I refuse to take the offer for this house.

regard.definition: If you have regard for something, you respect it.
regard.sentence: He has a high regard for his teacher.

regardless.definition: In spite of everything; without regard to drawbacks.
regardless.sentence: He carried on regardless of the difficulties.

region.definition: A region is an area of land or of the body.
region.sentence: The fishing problems have been happening only in the Atlantic coast region.

regional.definition: A regional office, centre, director, etc. is the one for that region.
regional.sentence: The head office called the regional office over a week ago.

register.definition: If you register someone or something, you put their name on a list.
register.sentence: Please take a moment to register your software with the company.

registration.definition: Registration is the process of registering something.
registration.sentence: The soccer club has registration at the school this week.

regret.definition: If you regret something that you have done, you feel sorry about it.
regret.sentence: I really regret forgetting to buy him a birthday present.

regular.definition: A regular event repeats after a similar amount of time or space.
regular.sentence: The best way to keep everyone happy is to have regular meetings.

regularly.definition: Regularly is when something is done often.

regulate.definition: If you regulate something, you control it by making laws and rules.
regulate.sentence: The industry has fought the state's attempts to regulate it.

regulation.definition: A regulation is a rule or a control.
regulation.sentence: The government is reducing regulation of the airlines.

reject.definition: If you reject an idea or belief, you decide that you do not believe it.
reject.sentence: Consumers have the right to reject problem goods and demand a refund.

relate.definition: If you relate, you tell something in a way that is descriptive.
relate.sentence: I cannot relate these events at all.

relation.definition: A relation is the way two things are towards each other or in comparison with each other.
relation.sentence: This building looks too big in relation to the size of the houses on the street.

relationship.definition: When there is a relationship between things, there is a connection.
relationship.sentence: There is a clear relationship between fire and heat.

relative.sentence: I feel good relative to yesterday.

relatively.definition: If something is relatively true, it is true in part.

relax.definition: If you relax, you stop working, worrying, etc., and you take a rest or have fun.
relax.sentence: If you don't relax your shoulders, you'll have a sore neck.

release.definition: If someone releases something, they let go of it; they stop holding it and set it free (let it be free).
release.sentence: Release a hormone into the blood stream.

relevant.definition: If something is relevant, it is connected to a topic in a meaningful way.
relevant.sentence: Our schools must aim to increase the quality of education and become more relevant to the needs of young people in modern society.

reliable.definition: Something or someone that is reliable can be trusted or believed.
reliable.sentence: Gideon is very reliable if he says he'll do something, he'll do it.!

relief.definition: Or (singular) Relief is the good feeling you have when something bad is finished or didn't happen.
relief.sentence: Most people are just breathing a sigh of relief that he's gone.

religion.definition: Religion is when a person or persons believe in a God or Gods.
religion.sentence: His religion is Christianity. Mine is Buddhism.

religious.definition: If something is religious, it is related to or about religion.
religious.sentence: Religious beliefs can be very important in choosing a marriage partner.

rely.definition: When someone relies on something, they need it and they feel certain that it will be there.
rely.sentence: In this place, you can't rely on good weather even in the summer.

remain.definition: If something remains it stays. It does not go away.
remain.sentence: I'll remain here as wait for you.

remark.definition: A remark is your spoken opinion or observation about something.

remarkable.definition: Something worth noticing; not common; extraordinary.
remarkable.sentence: It's remarkable that many mothers don't breastfeed their children, despite the evidence that it is good for babies to breastfeed.

remember.definition: If you remember something that you did or knew before, you can think of it again.
remember.sentence: He can't even remember where he left his books.

remind.definition: If you remind somebody of something, you tell them something they already know to make them think about it again.
remind.sentence: We doctors have to constantly remind ourselves to keep it simple.

remote.definition: Something that is remote is a long way off, distant, not near anything.
remote.sentence: The internet is a powerful tool for bringing modern medicine to remote areas.

remove.definition: If you remove something, you take it out or away.

rent.definition: Rent is the money you pay to borrow and use something, usually an apartment.
rent.sentence: Have we paid this month's rent yet?

repair.definition: If something is broken or damaged and a person repairs it, it's not broken or damaged anymore; to fix something.

repeat.definition: If you repeat something, you do it again.
repeat.sentence: I don't want to have to repeat typing this.

replace.definition: If X replaces Y or if you replace Y with X, X now does what Y used to do.
replace.sentence: I'm sorry, don't know how I'm going to replace your stolen bike.

reply.definition: If you reply to someone or something, you answer using words.
reply.sentence: I said hi and she did not reply.

report.definition: A report is a description of something that has happened.
report.sentence: There was a recent report on the election.

reporter.definition: A reporter is a person whose job is to learn and tell the news.
reporter.sentence: I would like to get a job as a reporter for the newspaper.

represent.definition: To represent is to stand in the place of; to act the part of (another).

representation.definition: Representation is the act of speaking or acting on behalf of someone.
representation.sentence: A Congressional vacancy occurred in the representation from California.

representative.definition: A representative is a person who represents a group or company.

reputation.definition: Reputation is what people think about someone or something because of things that happened in the past.
reputation.sentence: The restaurant had a bad reputation for its slow service.

request.definition: A request the act of asking for something (sometimes in a formal way).
request.sentence: We didn't hear his request that we be quiet.

require.definition: If you require something, you need it.
require.sentence: We require our secretary to be on time.

requirement.definition: A requirement is something that you need, something that is necessary.

rescue.definition: If you rescue someone, you save them from any violence, emergency, or evil.
rescue.sentence: The lifeguard jumped into the swimming pool to rescue the drowning woman.

research.definition: Research is the process or result of trying to find an answer by reading, interviewing, watching, or doing experiments.
research.sentence: We've been conducting research into the reason for the changes in these fish.

researcher.definition: A researcher is somebody who does research.

reserve.definition: If you reserve a room, a table, seat etc. you arrange for it to be kept for you, usually for a particular date and time.
reserve.sentence: We managed to reserve a table at Maxim's.

resident.definition: A resident is somebody who lives in a particular area.
resident.sentence: The resident was receiving special clinical training at the hospital.

resign.definition: If someone resigns from a job, they quit it.
resign.sentence: Resign a claim to the throne.

resist.definition: If you resist something, you work, push, fight, etc. against it.
resist.sentence: Unable to resist the call of the road, he left once more.

resistance.definition: Resistance is the act of opposing something, usually to oppose a change.
resistance.sentence: As I run, the resistance of the air slows me down by a bit, making it harder for me to run faster.

resolution.definition: A resolution is a formal decision, often after a vote.
resolution.sentence: The U.S. may be willing to support a Security Council resolution backing the return of inspectors to Iraq.

resolve.definition: To resolve means to create a solution for a problem.
resolve.sentence: He was able to resolve the argument with his boss by apologizing to her the next day and talking to her about what happened.

resort.definition: Buildings in a scenic area where people can go on vacation or to relax; resorts are like hotels that provide extra entertainment to their guests.
resort.sentence: Dan and Sarah went to an expensive resort in Jamaica for their honeymoon.

resource.definition: A resource is something that is available and useful.
resource.sentence: The local library is a valuable resource.

respect.definition: When someone respects another person that means they think the other person is worthy, responsible, strong or other good qualities.
respect.sentence: I have great respect for him and I'm sure he'll do well in life.

respectively.definition: If something is said to be respectively, it is said to be the case in a relative manner.
respectively.sentence: The brothers were called Felix and Max, respectively.

respond.definition: If you respond to something or someone, you do something in reaction to it.
respond.sentence: I try to respond to emails as soon as I get them.

response.definition: A response is some words or actions that happen as a reaction to something else.
response.sentence: We sent a message to them two weeks ago, but there has been no response so far.

responsibility.definition: A responsibility is any action which somebody trusts or expects that another person will do. Responsibilities are normally given or taken.
responsibility.sentence: He took that responsibility upon himself.

responsible.definition: If you are responsible for something, you did it or it happened because of something that you did.
responsible.sentence: The company was partly responsible for the success of the original product.

rest.sentence: You need to take a rest.

restaurant.definition: A restaurant is a place where you can buy and eat food and drinks.
restaurant.sentence: My wife and I went out to a small French restaurant in Toronto for dinner.

restore.definition: If you restore a state, feeling, or ability that has been lost, you make that possible or normal again.
restore.sentence: The government attempted to restore confidence by announcing tougher laws.

restrict.definition: If you restrict something, you limit it.
restrict.sentence: Restrict the use of this parking lot.

restriction.definition: A restriction is something that restricts or limits something else.
restriction.sentence: Because one student had bad food allergies, the school put a restriction on what kinds of food the other students were allowed to bring for lunch.

result.definition: The solution of a mathematical equation.
result.sentence: The result of losing the presents was that everyone was sad.

retail.definition: Retail is selling things, usually in small amounts.
retail.sentence: She owned a retail store, selling clothes in the main street.

retain.definition: If you retain something, you keep it.
retain.sentence: They joined the group but still managed to retain their independence at the same time.

retire.definition: If you retire, you stop working, usually because of your age.

retirement.definition: Retirement is the act of leaving one's job and stopping work permanently.

return.definition: When you return something, you give/put it back.
return.sentence: He was unable to return serves all through the match.

reveal.definition: If you reveal something, it was hidden and you show it or make it known.
reveal.sentence: The actress won't reveal how old she is.

revenue.definition: Revenue is the money that a business receives for doing business, and government receives from taxes.
revenue.sentence: The City is happy because a new source of revenue has been located.

reverse.definition: If you reverse something, you make it act or move opposite to before (in the other direction).
reverse.sentence: Now reverse your position by raising your right hand and lowering your left.

review.definition: A review is an evaluation of a publication, such as a movie, video game, musical composition, book, or a piece of hardware like a car, appliance, or computer.
review.sentence: After this negative review, they had to correct a lot of concerns.

revise.definition: When someone revises a book, a writing or something they said, it means they change it (edit it) so that it says something a little different from what it said before.
revise.sentence: I can't go out 'cause I have to revise for my A-levels.

revolution.definition: A revolution is a sudden significant change.
revolution.sentence: The Industrial Revolution began when machines were able to make things quicker and cheaper than people.

reward.definition: A reward is something good that is given after an act.
reward.sentence: He gave the dog a small thing to eat to reward it for sitting still.

rice.definition: Rice is a white or brown grain that people boil and eat.
rice.sentence: In many Asian countries, including Japan, China, and Thailand, they eat rice with almost every meal.

rich.definition: When someone is rich, they have a lot of money and things.

rid.definition: When you rid a thing, you free it of something not wanted.
rid.sentence: If you rid the house of a bad smell, you can close the window.

ride.definition: If you ride something, you sit on it while it moves.
ride.sentence: Did you ever ride a camel?

right.definition: When something is right, it is correct.

ring.sentence: The students sat in a ring.

rise.definition: A rise is an increase in something, is when something gets higher.
rise.sentence: I got a pay rise so now I can buy a bigger car.

risk.definition: A risk is something bad that could possibly happen.
risk.sentence: The risk of us failing is too great.

rival.definition: Your rival is someone who is competing or fighting with you for the same thing; a competitor.
rival.sentence: As a mountain climber, he has no rival in Switzerland.

river.sentence: We go swimming in the river.

road.definition: A long and narrow piece of land between two places. Usually, cars drive on it, and it is often paved.
road.sentence: The taxi is parked on the side of the road.

rock.definition: A hard substance that forms naturally in the Earth's surface.
rock.sentence: Rock music had direct influences from blues and rhythm and blues.

role.definition: The role of a person or thing is the job that they do in a certain situation.
role.sentence: In the past twenty-five years the role of women on farms had changed dramatically.

roll.definition: To roll is to move by turning over many times. Round things like balls can roll.

romantic.definition: Relating to romance, or good for romance.

roof.definition: A roof is the top part of a building.
roof.sentence: My five brothers, two sisters and seven cousins all live together under one roof.

room.definition: A room is a place which is part of a building. Someone is able to see other people who are in the same room.
room.sentence: We need a long, wide room because many people will be at the meeting.

root.definition: A root is a part of a tree or plant that is under the ground.
root.sentence: Hatred is the root of all evil.

rose.definition: A rose is a kind of shrub with red, pink, white or yellow flowers.

rough.definition: A rough is a person who is rude.

roughly.definition: If you do something roughly, you do it in a rough manner.

round.definition: Something is round if it's like a circle or like part of a circle. It is curved, not straight.

route.definition: A route is the way someone goes from one place to another place.
route.sentence: Could you tell me a route to the store from here?

routine.definition: Done like it is a routine. Hackneyed, shop-worn.
routine.sentence: He showed little interest in the flute sonata and played it in a routine manner.

row.definition: A row of things is a line of them, usually going from side to side.

royal.definition: To be royal means that someone is of a monarch or their family.

ruin.definition: To wreck something, to make it useless, to break something.
ruin.sentence: You will ruin your pencil if you press that hard.

rule.definition: A rule is a statement that tells whether you might get spanked for master baiting in class. If something is right or wrong.
rule.sentence: It was his rule to take a walk before breakfast.

run.definition: If you run, you go quickly, with both feet off the ground at one time.

rural.definition: If something is rural, it is related to the country and is not of the city.

rush.definition: If you rush, you move or work quickly.
